description:
A GUI client for gRPC and REST APIs with innovative features for environments, authorizations and more.

Kreya is a GUI client for gRPC, REST and WebSocket APIs. It makes calling APIs easy! Supported features:
- Kreya stores the files locally in JSON format for easy git-syncing (or any other syncing software)
- Unary, client-streaming, server-streaming and duplex requests (gRPC)
- Supports HTTP/2 and HTTP/3
- Authentication configurations - declare once, use everywhere
- Environment support combined with a powerful templating language
- Directory settings (ex. define the endpoint or authentication once for all requests)
- Scripting and tests
- kreyac, the Kreya CLI
- Server reflection (gRPC)
- OpenAPI import (REST)
- And more!
Features

- Core: user prompts in scripting and templating
- gRPC: allow changing mode from request header
- gRPC: support drag and drop in proto file importers
- gRPC: support proto edition 2024
- Importers: allow suppressing importer warnings
- Importers: remove brackets from generated file names during import
- Importers: support text imports and file drops
- Scripting: add access to vault secrets
- Scripting: ensure successful operation invocations
- Secrets: add HashiCorp Vault
- Secrets: add .NET user secrets vault
- Secrets: add Azure Key Vault support
- Secrets: auto-discover and map secrets
- UI: import collections during project setup
- UI: improve operation history browsing
- UI: modernize the welcome screen
- UI: show JSON and XPath breadcrumbs in response editors
- UI: show template parameter documentation on hover

Bug Fixes

- Auth: respect advanced options for operation auth
- Auth: show details for newly configured OAuth2 authentications
- Auth: track OIDC endpoint edits when saving authentications
- Core: allow opening projects when Git information cannot be loaded
- Core: avoid error when deleting empty scripts
- Core: cancel pending user messages when closing Kreya
- Core: improve performance for example value generation
- Core: preserve large request bodies during template rendering
- Core: prevent crash when closing application while a callback is pending
- Core: prevent sandbox escapes through directory symlinks
- Core: retain UI telemetry event properties
- Core: show helpful errors for recursive templates
- Core: update google proto files to latest version
- Importers: allow correcting failed importers during project setup
- Importers: include deleted importer operations after runs
- Importers: open first imported operation
- Importers: refresh environment templates before running importers
- Importers: truncate very long paths when importing
- macOS: run managed cleanup before native process exit
- REST: allow clearing the operation template
- REST: respect common OpenAPI constraints in example messages
- REST: show path controls for the selected streamed response
- Scripting: use response schemas for REST response content typings
- Secrets: allow copying automatically discovered secret names
- Secrets: keep vaults with conflicting template names accessible
- UI: add loading indication for large projects and collections
- UI: avoid nested scrolling in unimported dialog
- UI: improve layout and structure of advanced options form
- UI: improve performance by batching events
- UI: improve templating validation in JSON, XML and YAML editors
- UI: keep large operation collections responsive
- UI: keep large operation traces responsive
- UI: keep the loading screen centered when opening a project
- UI: preserve word wrap when switching operations
- UI: prevent toast overflow
- UI: prioritize quick action names and right-align paths
- UI: select the history tab when opening an operation history entry
- UI: show clipboard imports in the status bar
- UI: show pending invocation cancellation
- UI: support cancelling device authorization and retrying operations
